name: SoCal Speedcubing at Super STEM Saturday 2025

venue.name: CSU San Marcos
venue.address: 595 Campus View Dr, San Marcos, CA 92069

information: This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoCalSuperSTEMSaturday2025#54910-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information. ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTU3NzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--ca42a4de147a852f44595ef4931932442c21de35/2025_newcomer_logo_cropped.png) This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoCalSuperSTEMSaturday2025#54994-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab for more information. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized as part of [Super STEM Saturday](https://www.csusm.edu/superstem/index.html), in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
